description: This file defines serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes a codec class, a surrogate struct, and a copier class tailored for SortedDictionary objects, facilitating serialization, deserialization, and deep copying.

classes.name: SortedDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Codec class responsible for serializing and deserializing SortedDictionary instances using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: SortedDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate structure for SortedDictionary used during serialization, holding key-value pairs and optional comparer.

classes.name: SortedDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Class that provides deep copy functionality for SortedDictionary instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts from surrogate to a SortedDictionary instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedDictionary into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SortedDictionary.
